comparison.objective: Stops and brakes a rolling cart; candidate fractures and recovers four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic interception and brake actuation differ from recessed tool alignment, bimanual impact control, and millimetre-scale retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Cart arrest plus braking is title-supported; detailed thresholds are missing. Candidate requires four notch fractures, all tangs contained, and no damage or displacement.
comparison.reason: Both involve force control, but the tested mechanisms and outcomes are meaningfully different.
